thread:
marta: Deploybot flagged a regression hitting embeddings: increased 503 rate in eu-west1 after yesterday's overnight rollout. kvcache eviction path looks suspect. Requesting expedited hotfix deploy in the late change window. Canops + SRE signoff required.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Incident detection: embeddings-service > 5% 503s in eu-west1 (rolling average 10m). Candidate image: gcr/redwood/embeddings:2026.03.21-rc3. Canary passed basic smoke, failing under synthetic load. Link: https://ci/redwood/builds/9876 :warning:

marta: TL;DR: we need to push rc4 with the eviction guard fix. Low blast, single-region canary, then fast roll forward if green.

noah: Can you paste the rollback criteria? I want to confirm rollback command and thresholds.

marta: Rollback criteria: >3% 503s sustained for 5m post-canary OR embeddings latency p50 > 350ms for 3m. Rollback command: `./deploy rollback --service=embeddings --to-image=2026.03.20-stable`

alice: sgtm on criteria. Do we have a safety cutoff for total token throughput? If it spikes we should pause.

marta: Add cutoff: token throughput > +40% vs baseline for 5m => pause.

jason: I'll run quick perf probe against canary nodes once deploy completes. Need ops + oncall ack to expedite.

eng-release-lead: We can approve expedited in this window if SRE and oncall ack. Leaving note for release docs and postmortem if anything.

sre-oncall: I'm oncall. I approve expedited deploy for eu-west1 only. I'll monitor and can hit rollback. :thumbsup:

noah: +1 from me. I reviewed the fix diff, it's scoped. :eyes:

alice: +1. please tag release notes and keep canary at 2% traffic for 10 mins then 10% for 5 mins, then 50% for 5 mins before full.

marta: Noted. Deploy sequence: push image rc4 -> canary eu-west1 2% -> run smoke and perf probes -> 10% -> 50% -> full. If any threshold trips, immediate rollback.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Starting deploy pipeline: build triggered for gcr/redwood/embeddings:2026.03.21-rc4 (initiated by marta). Pipeline: lint -> unit -> canary-deploy -> smoke -> perf-probes. CI link: https://ci/redwood/builds/9880

jason: Build green. Kicking off canary deploy now. Watching perf probe results.

deploy-bot: [STATUS] Canary (2%) in eu-west1 up. Instances: 3. Smoke tests: pending.

jason: Smoke OK. Perf probe p50 210ms, p95 480ms. 503s 0.6% so far.

alice: Holding at 2% for 10m per plan. Reporting back on metrics any minute.

sre-oncall: All good so far. If we get to 10% and metrics look stable, i'm fine to proceed.

marta: Thanks all — documenting approvals: sre-oncall, noah, alice, eng-release-lead. Proceeding with ramp. :rocket: 

deploy-bot: [STATUS] Ramp to 10% complete. Perf probe results: p50 220ms, p95 520ms, 503s 0.9%.

noah: metrics stable. Proceed to 50%.

deploy-bot: [STATUS] Ramp to 50% complete. Monitoring...

jason: Quick check: token throughput +12% (within cutoff). No errors spiking.

alice: Proceed to full. I'll update release notes after cutoff.

deploy-bot: [DONE] Full rollout complete for gcr/redwood/embeddings:2026.03.21-rc4. Post-deploy checks passed. Closing expedited hotfix window.

marta: Great work. Filing a short post-deploy note and marking this hotfix under 'late-window-exempt' for billing. Follow-up: short blameless postmortem on the eviction heuristics. :white_check_mark:

eng-release-lead: Thank you team. Adding release note: "Embeddings: kvcache eviction fix to reduce 503s in eu-west1; rolled 2026.03.21-rc4."

sre-oncall: Marking incident resolved. Will keep an eye for 1hr.
